claim: ADB's later evaluation reported that about 60% of Sri Lanka's tsunami damage was concentrated on the east and northeast coasts.

metric.denominator: estimated total tsunami damage in Sri Lanka
metric.geography: east and northeast coasts of Sri Lanka
metric.basis: ADB evaluation drawing on joint needs assessment
metric.source_definition: share of total damage, not share of deaths or aid

bounded_by: Damage concentration does not by itself prove discriminatory aid allocation.
notes: Makes geographic asymmetry explicit before aid-distribution analysis.
